name: Enoch
summary: A man in the family line from Adam who walked with God and was the father of Methuselah. He did not die; God took him.

key_moments.title: Father of Methuselah
key_moments.description: When Enoch was 65, his son Methuselah was born. Enoch walked with God for 300 years after that and had other sons and daughters.

key_moments.title: Taken by God
key_moments.description: Enoch walked with God, and then he was gone, because God took him. By faith he was taken so that he would not see death, for he had pleased God.

key_moments.title: A Warning of Judgment
key_moments.description: Enoch, the seventh from Adam, foretold that the Lord would come with many thousands of His saints to judge everyone and convict the ungodly.
